description.value:
From Enigma · Price: you can seal a creature only while it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} or more (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} or more from 9th).

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: Seal (1 action): fold a paper around an unattended object or a hazard within your stand's reach (a fire, boiling water, a falling stone); it stays sealed until you unfold it. Unfold (1 action): open a sealed paper at a creature within 30 ft, and what it held bursts out: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage of that kind (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}; fire if unsure); on a failure, also 1d6 persistent damage of that kind and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a critical failure).
  • 5: Unfold hits creatures you choose in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst} within 30 ft. Surge: fold up to two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened} creatures within 30 ft into paper (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation). Failure: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} as the paper half-closes on it. Critical failure: sealed for 1 round. A sealed creature is folded into the paper: it can't act, perceive, or be targeted or harmed, and when the sealing ends it reappears where the paper is.
  • 9: Frightened 1 is enough to seal. Unfold's persistent damage is 2d6.
  • 13: Seal up to three creatures.
  • 17: Sealing lasts 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
